CustomField.description: If SAT PNR Status is KK/HK/RR then it would be a confirmed PNR.
CustomField.formula: IF( CONTAINS(text(Case_ID__r.Route__c) , "one-way") , Departing_PNR_Status__c="KK"|| Departing_PNR_Status__c="HK"|| Departing_PNR_Status__c="RR"|| Returning_PNR_Status__c="KK"|| Returning_PNR_Status__c="HK"|| Returning_PNR_Status__c="RR" , ( Departing_PNR_Status__c="KK"|| Departing_PNR_Status__c="HK"|| Departing_PNR_Status__c="RR" )&& ( Returning_PNR_Status__c="KK"|| Returning_PNR_Status__c="HK"|| Returning_PNR_Status__c="RR" ) )
CustomField.label: Is All Itinerary Confirmed(formula)
